title: Real Image Denoising with Knowledge Distillation for High-Performance Mobile NPUs
summary: NPU-aware hardware-algorithm co-design for real-world image denoising on mobile NPUs. LiteDenoiseNet (1.96M params) runs 34ms on Dimensity 9500 and 46.1ms on Snapdragon 8 Elite. Achieves 21.2x parameter reduction with only 0.05dB PSNR gap from teacher.

title: Mobile-friendly Image de-noising: Hardware Conscious Optimization for Edge Application
summary: Entropy-Regularized differentiable NAS on hardware-aware search space for U-Net denoising. 12% fewer params, ~2x latency improvement on Samsung Galaxy S24 Ultra. ~18x GMACs reduction vs SwinIR.

title: DnLUT: Ultra-Efficient Color Image Denoising via Channel-Aware Lookup Tables
summary: LUT-based ultra-efficient color image denoising. Pairwise Channel Mixer (PCM) + L-shaped convolution. 500KB storage, 0.1% energy of DnCNN, 20x faster inference. Outperforms all LUT methods by >1dB PSNR.

title: NTIRE 2025 Challenge on Efficient Burst HDR and Restoration
summary: Multi-frame HDR restoration challenge with RAW fusion dataset (9 frames/scene). Efficiency constraints: <30M params, <4T FLOPs. Top result: 43.22dB PSNR. Highly relevant to MFNR/RAWHDR mobile pipeline.

title: AIM 2025 Challenge on Real-World RAW Image Denoising
summary: Real-world RAW denoising challenge with multi-camera evaluation. Combines full-reference (PSNR, SSIM, LPIPS) and no-reference (ARNIQA, TOPIQ) metrics. Promotes camera-agnostic low-light RAW denoising from synthetic data.

title: Learned Smartphone ISP on Mobile GPUs, Mobile AI 2025 Challenge
summary: Mobile AI 2025 challenge on learned ISP for mobile GPUs. Large-scale aligned smartphone RAW/DSLR image pairs dataset. Focus on fast inference on mobile GPUs.

title: Lightweight Network Towards Real-Time Image Denoising on Mobile Devices (MFDNet)
summary: Identifies memory access cost and NPU-incompatible operations as real mobile bottlenecks. Proposes MFA attention module and RepConv reparameterization. SOTA on SIDD and DND under real-time latency.

title: Practical Deep Raw Image Denoising on Mobile Devices (PMRID)
summary: Lightweight, efficient neural network-based raw image denoiser that runs smoothly on mainstream mobile devices with high quality results. Foundational work for mobile RAW denoising.

title: DRNet: All-in-One Image Restoration via Prior-Guided Dynamic Reparameterization
summary: DRNet operates on initialization-stage reconfiguration paradigm, eliminating per-input overhead. DRMLP guided by TSM mitigates task heterogeneity. CWTE leverages frequency characteristics for lightweight design. SOTA across five restoration tasks with superior parameter efficiency.

title: Pre-training Enables Extraordinary All-optical Image Denoising
summary: Pre-training-driven approach for all-optical image denoising via diffractive network. Two-step: pre-train on 3.45M diverse simple images, then fine-tune on task-specific data. Improves PSNR from <8dB to >18dB on severely noisy images.

title: Energy-efficient Integer-only vs. Floating-point FLBMF Filters for Low-power Embedded Image Denoising
summary: Systematic evaluation of integer-only vs floating-point FLBMF filters for embedded image denoising. Integer-only reduces memory by 40% and execution time by 55% on ARM Cortex-M7, with DeltaPSNR <= 0.5dB. Tested on MCU and FPGA platforms.

title: Calibration-Free Raw Image Denoising via Fine-Grained Noise Estimation
summary: Calibration-free RAW noise estimation pipeline. Only requires dark frames, reducing preparation from days to ~1 hour. Fine-grained statistical noise model for realistic noise synthesis. Effective in both normal and low-light scenarios.

title: Towards Controllable Real Image Denoising with Camera Parameters
summary: Controllable denoising framework using camera parameters (ISO, shutter speed, F-number) as control vectors. Seamlessly adds controllability to standard denoising networks and improves performance. Code available.

title: Learned Lightweight Smartphone ISP with Unpaired Data
summary: Unpaired training method for learned ISPs. Multi-discriminator adversarial training with multi-term loss to maintain content structure while learning target RGB characteristics. Lightweight backbone for mobile deployment. Evaluated on Zurich RAW-to-RGB and Fujifilm UltraISP datasets.

title: The Tenth NTIRE 2025 Image Denoising Challenge Report
summary: NTIRE 2025 Image Denoising Challenge (sigma=50) report. 290 participants, 20 valid submissions. AWGN fixed noise level. No computational complexity constraints. Provides systematic comparison of SOTA denoising architectures.

title: Low-light Image Denoising with Learnable Diffusion Prior
summary: First multi-task diffusion model integrating noise prediction and removal for low-light RAW images. Interaction module adaptively extracts noise and context to handle non-uniform noise and content overlap.

title: Denoising as Adaptation: Noise-Space Domain Adaptation for Image Restoration (Noise-DA)
summary: First noise-space domain adaptation for image restoration. Anti-shortcut learning strategy aligns synthetic and real data distributions. Diffusion model discarded after training, zero extra inference cost. General and flexible across restoration tasks.
